$comment: PinoCut Director tool schemas v1. Portable JSON Schema function definitions — usable as Claude tools, OpenAI function-calling tools, or Custom GPT Actions (categories 1-3 are structured-output tools the model fulfils itself; category 4 'engine' tools map to the pinocut Python engine / HTTP wrapper).

tools.name: analyze_story
tools.description: Analyze a raw idea/script into story structure and an emotional arc map. Use in Phase 1 before any shot list.

raw_idea.description: The user's idea, script, or voice-note transcript, verbatim.

desired_viewer_action.description: What the viewer should feel or do at the end.

tools.returns: StoryAnalysis: { logline, acts: [{beat, purpose, time_budget_sec}], emotional_arc: [{t_sec, emotion, intensity_0_10}], hook_strategy, risks }

tools.name: create_shot_list
tools.description: Turn an approved StoryAnalysis into a numbered shot list with camera language, duration, movement, lighting intent, emotional purpose, and asset source per shot. Durations must sum to target ±5%.
tools.returns: ShotList: [{ id, source: LIVE|SCREEN|GEN|HYBRID, description, framing, camera_movement, lighting_intent, duration_sec, emotional_purpose }]

tools.name: generate_grok_image_prompts
tools.description: Generate a consistency-engineered Grok prompt pack for all GEN shots: style bible anchor block, character sheet prompts (canonical views, generated first), and per-shot prompts composed as [style anchor]+[verbatim character anchor]+[shot specifics]+[avoid list].

shot_list.description: Output of create_shot_list; only GEN/HYBRID shots are processed.

tools.returns: PromptPack: { style_bible, character_sheets: [{character, prompts[]}], shot_prompts: [{shot_id, prompt, avoid, consistency_notes}], qc_checklist }

tools.name: suggest_edit_plan
tools.description: Produce the Resolve edit plan: assembly→rough→fine strategy, per-section pacing targets (avg cut length), specific cut types (J/L, match, on-action) with rationale, and timeline/track architecture.

style_profile.description: User style memory (pacing taste etc.); optional.

tools.returns: EditPlan: { track_layout, sections: [{shots, pacing_avg_cut_sec, cut_types: [{between, type, rationale}]}], rough_cut_checklist }

tools.name: design_resolve_grade
tools.description: Design a Resolve color node tree for the project: ordered nodes with purpose, exact starting values (lift/gamma/gain, sat, hue curves), qualifier/power-window specs, LUT recommendation and placement, and scope-based verification steps.

look_direction.description: e.g. 'clean corporate with slight teal-amber split tone'.

footage_notes.description: Camera/log format, lighting conditions, mixed sources.

tools.returns: GradeSpec: { node_tree: [{n, label, purpose, settings}], lut: {name, position}, scopes_checks[], per_platform_notes }

tools.name: plan_fairlight_audio
tools.description: Design the Fairlight audio strategy: per-track processing chains with exact values, loudness target, music ducking spec, and a sound-design beat map aligned to the shot list.

dialog_condition.description: e.g. 'lav mic, quiet room' or 'laptop mic, echoey'.

tools.returns: AudioPlan: { tracks: [{name, chain: [{fx, settings}]}], loudness_target_lufs, ducking: {amount_db, ramp_ms}, sound_design_beats[] }

tools.name: generate_resolve_python_script
tools.description: Generate a complete, runnable Python script against the official DaVinci Resolve Scripting API (DaVinciResolveScript) for a given task: project bootstrap, media import with bins/metadata, timeline population from a shot list, or render-queue setup. Must include env setup, error handling, and honest comments where the API has no coverage.

media_root.description: Absolute path to the project media folder.

render_preset.description: Output of generate_export_preset; used for setup_render_queue.

tools.name: create_project_structure
tools.description: Emit the standard PinoCut project folder tree (mkdir script + README.md template) for a new project.

tools.name: generate_export_preset
tools.description: Exact Resolve Deliver-page settings for a target platform: codec, container, resolution, bitrate/quality, color space tag, audio codec + loudness.
tools.returns: ExportPreset: { format, codec, resolution, bitrate, color_space, audio: {codec, bitrate, lufs}, notes }

tools.name: scene_build
tools.description: PinoCut Engine: assemble a scene from a folder of clips (CLI `pinocut scene build`). Runs selection, trim, transitions, audio, and renders an mp4 + TimelineV1 JSON + SceneOps snapshot.

goal.description: Scene goal, e.g. 'tense night-time reveal of the prototype'.

wait_bassito.description: Block until generative jobs finish and re-assemble.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: PinoCut Engine: fast low-res proxy render (480p ultrafast) of the current scene state for iteration.

tools.name: export_scene
tools.description: PinoCut Engine: full-quality render of a TimelineV1 with an export profile.

profile.description: Export profile name (maps to generate_export_preset platforms).

tools.name: request_bridge_shot
tools.description: PinoCut Engine (Bassito): queue generation of a missing bridge shot between two clips. Returns a job; the regeneration loop re-assembles the scene when done.

tools.name: request_extend
tools.description: PinoCut Engine (Bassito): extend an existing clip generatively (or ffmpeg fallback) when it is too short for its slot.

tools.name: request_restyle
tools.description: PinoCut Engine (Bassito): restyle a clip to match the scene's look (generative restyle or LUT/stabilize fallback).
